summary_markdown:
The conversation focused heavily on improving the staging analytics dashboard. Several specific UI/UX changes were discussed, including:

*   **Dashboard Layout:** Adjusting map alignment to edges, updating real-time charts (to match a reference image), disabling pedestrian/transport charts for real-time views, removing the word 'filters', and eliminating light backgrounds from filter edit boxes.
*   **Real-Time Block:** Attempted collapsing of the real-time block was discussed but proved difficult.
*   **Asset Editor:** Needs updates to include images and map previews during asset editing.
*   **Session Metrics:** A decision was made to combine total sessions (open + closed) into the real-time view, although concerns were raised about potential decreasing values in this combined metric.
decisions: The staging analytics dashboard requires multiple UI/UX updates (map alignment, chart redesign, filter box styling).
Total session count (open + closed) will be added to the real-time view.
action_items: Implement remaining UI/UX changes on the analytics dashboard.
Update asset editor to support image and map previews.
